tickets.title: Collaterate uploads are spinning

Re-upload/time resolved it, not a manual dev re-trigger.

tickets.title: New file Uploads Are Spinning in Collaterate

No files needed re-uploading — they just needed time to process. (The AI's cited example jobs were even noted as being from 2021.)

However, it missed the specific mechanism — the problem wasn't that AOD failed to filter hidden items, but rather that the cascading logic was incorrectly hiding ALL child items when only the parent bay was marked for exclusion.
